description: The pie chart, titled "6 Matches," displays the distribution of matching statistics across six categories labeled 0 through 5. The largest segment, corresponding to category 0, is light yellow and represents 27.2% of the total (8006 instances). The second largest segment, category 2, is a pale green and accounts for 22.4% (6583 instances). Category 1 is light cream-colored and makes up 13.8% (4046 instances), while category 0 (the first segment) is 13.3% (3910 instances). The remaining categories are smaller: category 5 is light blue and represents 10.4% (3043 instances), category 4 is a slightly darker blue and accounts for 6.2% (1810 instances), and category 3 is olive green and represents 6.8% (2002 instances). The percentages are clearly labeled within each slice, and the chart includes a legend indicating the category labels. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest slice positioned at the top.
